rootCause: An in-place provider extension could mutate a cached lookup and then raise while its old committed version remained valid. Equivalent atom identity hits could reuse the poisoned lookup.
correction: Revoke entry validity before provider extension; publish the returned lookup and prospective version only on success. Failed entries are rebuilt from committed rows on the next indexed read.

lean.scope: Unchanged indexed traversal algebra assumes current-snapshot candidates. Recovery protocol belongs to TLA+ and native checks.

tla.scope: Finite two-owner single-bucket extension/install, failed mutation invalidation and rebuild/retry. No general native refinement or liveness claim.

native.faultControl: Frozen prior index implementation returns injected (0 999) after mutate-then-raise; corrected implementation excludes it.
qualifications: Failed extension reconstructs committed total rows
Equivalent atom alias resolves the shared revoked entry
Delta cache and source rows/version remain unchanged by total failure
Successful retry installs the intended next rows
Successful path preserves callback/row order; failure path adds one rebuild
Recursive scalar/composite indexes match independent truth for workers 1, 2 and 4

actorOwnership: Source inspection: positive actor workers construct private indexes over frozen row/size/version vector copies. No shared worker cache added.
remaining: General cache/provider and asynchronous execution trace refinement
General abstract gamma/injection and termination contracts
